project: AuraDocs Enterprise Documentation & Code Sandbox Portal
description: Complete Knowledge Graph mapping full Frontend components, Backend API endpoints, REST connectivity links, language registry, ALL 4 Dockerfiles, 3 Docker compose services, and ALL 12 Knowledge Base courses.

dockerfiles.description: Builds React static bundle and packages FastAPI backend with Python 3.11, Node, Java 17, Go, C++, and all 12 KB courses into unified production container.
Builds isolated CentOS Stream 9 container for terminal execution and bash/VIM learning.
Builds backend dev container with Python 3.11, Node, Java 17, Go, SQLite, GCC, and Uvicorn server.
Builds frontend dev container running Vite hot-reload server.

frontend_to_backend_api_matrix.purpose: Populates Knowledge Base dropdown list by scanning doc_* folders.
Generates collapsible directory navigation tree for sidebar.
Fetches course metadata, quizzes, modules, and code templates.
Serves raw markdown document content with LFI security checks.
Executes vector search & generates grounded AI answers with source citations.
Executes code/bash in Docker container and returns stdout/stderr.
Returns tab autocomplete suggestions for shell commands and paths.
Retrieves registered execution languages and runtime health status.
